topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture objectives, reviews previous material on cancer genetics, and presents the framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in pathways such as Wnt/beta-catenin, RTK/Ras/MAPK, and PI3K/Akt drive cancer cell proliferation and survival independently of external controls.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells halt normal lineage differentiation across hematopoietic malignancies and epithelial carcinomas to sustain proliferative potential.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms of apoptotic evasion, focusing on the regulation of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization by p53, Bax, and BCL2.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss how cancer cells overcome the Hayflick limit through telomerase activation and evade senescence and p53-mediated stress responses.

topics.label: Deregulating Cellular Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the Warburg effect, metabolic rewiring across different tumor types, and the interplay between metabolic mutations and epigenetic regulation.

topics.label: Inducing Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how tumors stimulate new blood vessel formation to overcome oxygen and nutrient diffusion limits during progression.

topics.label: Cancer Metastasis and Dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the metastatic cascade, diagnostic tracking of dissemination, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, and the genomic features underlying metastatic colonization.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by summarising the hallmarks framework, discussing recent conceptual extensions, and taking questions.
